mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (above 4.5%) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.5%) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points and increase in employment (PAYEMS) by more than 10,000 persons over the last month signals a strong labor market, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (UNRATE decline > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increase > 10000) is met in more than 60% of instances but SPX 20d returns are not positive in more than 40% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong demand regime, defined by year-over-year GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% and housing starts (HOUST) above 1300, supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The strong demand regime condition (GDPC1 growth > 2% and HOUST > 1300) is met in more than 60% of instances but SPX 60d returns are not positive in more than 40% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production level (INDPRO) above 115 signals robust supply conditions, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 115 is met in more than 60% of instances but SPX 5d returns are not positive in more than 40% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth above 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% is met in more than 60% of instances but SPX 60d returns are not negative in more than 40% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 500 units and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 50,000 million dollars over the last month signals strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (HOUST increase > 500 and RSAFS increase > 50000) is met in more than 60% of instances but SPX 5d returns are not positive in more than 40% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, defined by unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5%, supports wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.5 is met in more than 60% of instances but SPX 60d returns are not positive in more than 40% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
